trigger_condition.state_trigger: Upstream archive is exhausted and closed while downstream buffered consumer still holds unread yielded member streams.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Buffered consumer such as Shuffler requests more elements than the tar archive contains, forcing archive exhaustion before yielded streams are consumed.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Pipeline uses TarArchiveReader followed by a buffered consumer such as Shuffler; buffer_size is greater than the number of archive entries; yielded archive member streams are read only after the archive has been exhausted and closed.

bug_oracle.description: Exception is raised when consuming a yielded stream after the owning tar archive has been closed.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate tar archives with varying entry counts, entry sizes, compression formats, and directory structures; vary member stream sizes and include empty files.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create file-based data sources and downstream buffered datapipe consumers with configurable buffer sizes.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Set the buffered consumer buffer_size to exceed the upstream archive entry count so the upstream archive is exhausted before yielded member streams are consumed.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Construct a datapipe pipeline: archive reader followed by buffering or shuffling consumer. Trigger iteration to fill the buffer and exhaust the archive, then read the previously yielded member streams.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Monitor for exceptions or invalid stream states when reading yielded streams after archive exhaustion; compare behavior against direct tarfile member reads.
